datum.name: Iteration 002 robot frame = taps-02 root: chassis centre on the factory-tire floor (Z = 0), +X toward the dump (reef) face, +Y port, +Z up, millimetres

missingInputs: Open narrative objective: Sustain a deliverable load: keep custody when accelerating, braking or contacted, and detect displacement or loss
Open narrative objective: Release into the intended L1 trough sector A, clear the wall and leave the pipe supported after withdrawal

narrativeReview.read: Read end to end on 2026-11-21: the opening LEAVE, two TELEOP station-to-L1 cycles in sectors A and B, custody, trough release and support, park, the endgame choice and the empty-start fallback. commissioning.md restates the two-pipe objective for iteration 002.

objectives.objective: AUTO: leave the starting line with the whole occupied robot (3 points)
objectives.basis: A field-route objective for the empty robot; this package reserves the stowed starting configuration (940.5 mm tall, perimeter 2919.8 mm) but has no field fixture. Replay the opening-line study with the 17.25 mm rear cutback in the field rehearsal.

objectives.objective: TELEOP: take one station-issued CORAL from the red station (front approach)
objectives.basis: Cases receive-chute, receive-over-edge and receive-seat; premises station-receive-face, station-receive-time and station-arrival-speed.

objectives.objective: Carry it to the red reef while crossing peer routes
objectives.basis: Case loaded-carry (seated pipe in the pan hold band; steer covered by the static revolved envelopes); weak-pack voltage premise; peer traffic is field-side.

objectives.objective: Sustain a deliverable load: keep custody when accelerating, braking or contacted, and detect displacement or loss
objectives.basis: retention-review.json: no positive restraint on the open face at stow; powered events lift the pipe 24-114 ms (study-06); unpowered holding loses it at 3 g opening contact (study-05). No seated-pipe sensor or camera view is placed in this layout.

objectives.objective: Release into the intended L1 trough sector A, clear the wall and leave the pipe supported after withdrawal
objectives.basis: Cases tip-to-dump, release and reset-to-stow carry the pipe out past the pan edge, and the dock-support-margin premise holds the replay support; the reef wall and trough fixture are not placed, so whole-robot wall clearance at the 12 mm stand-off is not checked in this package.

objectives.objective: Return for a second station CORAL and score it in sector B with the first pipe as an obstacle
objectives.basis: The same ordered cycle repeats from reset-to-stow; sector B timing and the first-pipe obstacle are covered by the twelve-case replays behind the premises.

objectives.objective: PARK: reserve the south lane, stow, reach the zone and stop
objectives.basis: Case park (withdraw 300 mm from the scored pipe, pan stowed); the lane reservation is field-side.

objectives.objective: Endgame alternatives: shallow or deep CAGE
objectives.basis: The selected role parks; the occupied receiver has no demonstrated climb route (selected-role.md).
The stowed starting configuration and the park case are the same robot with no pipe aboard.

objectives.objective: Partner and station dependence: Red 1 station change and station depletion
objectives.basis: An alliance-chain and field-supply comparison owned by conceptual design; it changes no package volume.

premises.scenario: Both TELEOP station receives (18-153 s) at the red station, front approach
Station feed at 21.1 s to scheduled carry start at 27.032 s (coral-A), adverse mass and battery
Twelve L1 placements, sectors A and B, nominal and adverse, at the 12 mm earlier dock stand-off
Pipe arrival at the receiver from the station chute, adverse admission
R103 heavy single-contingency estimate of the inspected configuration
Every cycle stage on the weak 11.8 V / 32 mOhm pack at the conservative simultaneous current
552-r5 electronics placements, battery gauge and wiring reserves inside the r3 upper support
Carried-forward iteration 002 chassis as a revisable premise of this layout, not a fixed boundary
Guarded pan r3 proposal geometry (pivot, stow 70 deg, dump -2 deg, stops, inlet) as a revisable premise
Four tapped nutbar holes and seated 1/4-20 x 1 in screws on the inset brace clamps as a revisable premise
Selected scoring architecture after the matched fixed-path comparison (12 cases)
